title: Her Son Slips Under An Icy River And Stops Moving . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Wolf Children, Hana raises two wolf kids alone in the mountains. Then her son slips under an icy river and stops moving. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#wolfchildren #anime #animemovie #recap #animerewind

segments.say: Hana plunges into an icy river, and her son is not *moving*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day she moves her wolf kids to the *mountains*.
The house is a wreck, but the kids love the *yard*, and Hana scrubs every floor herself.
She makes one rule. Being wolf children is their little *secret*.
Then her tomatoes die, and the grumpy farmer next door calls her a damn *fool*.
But he keeps bossing her around, until she learns to dig, plant, and *grow*.
Soon the whole village pitches in, and she has more potatoes than three people can *eat*.
Then winter comes, and Yuki and Ame race through the snow as *wolves*.
Hana laughs right behind them. Nothing can go *wrong*.
But then the icy river pulls Ame *under*.
Hana drags him out, and he is not *moving*.
She screams at him to open his *eyes*.
The full story is on our page.
